newsitem.title: UK: William Baird in 23 mln stg disposals.
newsitem.headline: William Baird in 23 mln stg disposals.

text.p: British clothing designer and manufacturer William Baird Plc said on Monday it had sold five clothing and gift businesses for 23 million stg to a company owned by 3I Group Plc and investment funds.

Baird said the businesses were Bridal Fashions, Praxis Tailoring supplying ladies tailoring, Joshua Wardle, a commission dyer, finisher and printer, Robenau Toys and Cowley Designs, supplying artificial flowers, Christmas products and gifts.
Baird said one million stg of the 23 million price would be deferred. The overall price would be adjusted to the value of net assets at completion over the next two years.
Baird said the disposals were part of its restructuring programme announced in October last year.
